t: Lesson 8, governance. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani, how to roll agents out to a team safely.
Governance needs two sets of rules. Rules for the agents, written in their context files,
and rules for the people, written down where everyone can see them.
Start with data. Decide what never goes in a prompt, which tools the agents may connect to,
Then permissions. Allow list the safe commands, so it can move fast on the boring stuff.
Deny anything sensitive, like your secrets file. Everything else the agent asks first,
and keep a log of what it changed.
Finally, roll out in steps. Pilot with one team for 30 days. Share a skills library in Git.
Review it every month, and keep what works.
Quick recap. Two rule books, least access, ask before write, and a small pilot.
Your mission, write a one-page AI playbook for your team, and pick the pilot group.
That's the core course. Next two masterclasses, first up one must act.
